description: Use this when the user asks for promo codes, coupons, deals or first-year discounts. Returns coupon codes as each registrar's own API or promotions page lists them (code, operation, extensions, discount, limits, end date, last seen at the source, an example price with the code), and running promotional prices anyone gets without a code. Codes are seen at the source, not tested at checkout; quote the list price and renewal too.

active_only.description: false: also coupons that expired in the last 30 days

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for prices (default USD); converted at the ECB's daily rate, disclosed in `fx`

tld.description: an extension: com, .io, co.uk or рф
